body:
Adopt pinned MIT jevlint as an advisory PR taste check through CARR's existing Jev admission authority. Leave this PR unmerged. The command emits JSON and exit 0 (clean), 1 (advisory findings), or 2 (unavailable/refused).

The CLI materializes exact committed PR head blobs into a stable scratch Git workspace and runs only `check --changed`. Git tree lookup uses literal pathspecs and NUL records, validates the exact regular-blob entry, and reads its object ID. The original worktree and index remain read only. Install metadata pins upstream commit `73a7a94ab08a4e314709d68c2863687a4646f29b`; no binary is committed.

The loopback SystemOne shim routes judgments through `ops/typesafe_client.py`, registered caller `jevlint_review`, and session/PR/head attribution. Accepted sockets have idle and absolute request deadlines; teardown closes the active connection before shutdown. A stalled header or body makes the review unavailable and cannot hold teardown indefinitely. Vendor work also receives an absolute eight-second deadline. The upstream process receives only a public loopback marker.

Paid-attempt receipts observe committed canonical reservations in this run's execution context, matched to its caller and session, and identify the run and UTC day counts. They include failed Worker attempts and direct fallback attempts, while retry-cache hits, Worker cache hits and refusals contribute no admissions. They do not reconstruct spending from global bucket differences or create another spend authority. Shared budget remains 500/day with subordinate site quotas of 150/hour and 200/day.

One canonical rule remains: `wrapper-without-value`, confidence floor 0.93. It catches project-local aliases that only forward caller-supplied arguments and add no policy, validation, transformation or error translation. Fixed identifier/judge policies and required transport/framework interfaces are controls. `invariant-helper` is removed because it reports the same defect on the same controls. The eight retained wrapper cases all match the historical calibrated observations, including three reported failures and zero inconclusive results. `calibration.json` records a deterministic projection by indices into the unchanged original observations; no new quality measurement is claimed.

Historical calibration rounds and PR samples retain their original two-rule configuration and outputs. The old paid measurements used caller-global differences and are now explicitly marked as unreliable run-cost evidence because concurrent usage and retained previous-day pruning were not excluded. No current one-rule paid cost measurement or independent precision estimate is claimed. Other candidate rules remain declined for duplicated predicates or missing positive coverage in the consumed corpus.

The latest review blockers are resolved:

1. Stalled loopback headers/body: bounded idle and absolute lifetime, active-connection teardown, subsequent-request and runner unavailable/exit-2 regression coverage.
2. Unbound paid counts: canonical post-commit observations scoped to run/session/caller, with previous-day pruning, concurrent same-caller/session runs, midnight, retries, cache hits, refusal and failed Worker/fallback tests.
3. Git pathspec magic and uncaught missing entry: literal NUL tree lookup, entry validation, object-ID blob reads, legal filename and complete JSON/exit-2 CLI tests.
4. Duplicate forwarding policy: remove `invariant-helper` from active configuration and cases; retain historical observations under their original configuration.

Validation: regression tests reproduced the blockers before fixes. Offline Jevlint acceptance tests, shared admission tests, existing TypeSafe tests, mypy and whitespace checks pass. The installed pinned CLI is exercised against a recorded response without paid vendor calls. The full `ops/ci.sh --strict` run completed in the foreground: its non-unit/non-migration classes passed, including all 504 gate selftest suites and all 7,384 replayed verdicts. Units initially lacked the pinned Wrangler dependency; after `npm ci --prefix practice-plugin`, the complete unit class rerun passed. Migration initially skipped without a configured disposable database; `./run.sh local-db-ci --class migration --port 55440` then passed all 69 DB acceptance programs and the wrapper's additional acceptance and cleanup checks. Thus every local class has passing evidence; the initial strict invocation itself returned nonzero. Machine-only drift in two unrelated launchd declarations was reported by binding and was nonfatal under its existing policy. All test runs stayed in the foreground. The TypeSafe change invalidates a dependency of the rule-delivery receipt; the deterministic baseline/candidate cohorts were freshly replayed with the existing harness, producing unchanged scores and a refreshed source-bound receipt. CI discovers the offline Jevlint selftest and makes no paid calls. Both codebase-design and zero-tech-debt passes were applied to the final change.

no-eval: jev-judgments: No prior jevlint review baseline or independent sealed positive corpus exists for a quality-delta measurement; the requested deletion examples were consumed for calibration. Existing observations are retained and projected for the sole surviving predicate. Transport, counting and failure contracts are tested deterministically without claiming model quality improvement.
